## Welcome

This short course introduces RStudio and base R through examples from air quality. Work through the preparation at your own pace before the first group session.

## Before Week 8

1. Use [What is RStudio?](01-what_is_rstudio.qmd) to install R and RStudio or find out how to access them through UCL.
2. Work through the [Base R primer](02-base_r_primer.qmd). Allow 30–45 minutes to run the examples and try the exercises.

## Group sessions

Both group sessions run from **11 am to noon**.

| Session | Worksheet |
|---|---|
| Week 8 | [London air quality: relationships](09-london_airquality_relationships.qmd) |
| Week 9 | [London air quality: t-tests](10-london_airquality_ttests.qmd) |
